Definition: The DEL-02-02 contract for unit-aware quantities and dimensional analysis in the domain core; structural, shipping no protected standards data.
The closed set of dimension identifiers (dimensionless, length, mass, ... mass_per_length, volume_per_length, slope, TBD) used as a structural checking contract.
Internal calculations performed in SI canonical units with display-unit conversion transforms.
Interval (difference) temperature dimension, converted without offset; replaces retired temperature_difference.
Provenance classification of a conversion declaration: SiCanonical, ExactPublicDefinition, ConventionalPublicConstant, ProjectGovernedDecision.
Explicit pressure kind (Absolute or Gauge); conversion across kinds requires an explicit pressure reference and provenance.
A finding raised when a solve-required or rule-check-required unit is missing; never a silent default.
Straight-pipe element adapting explicit section properties and nodes into the frame-kernel solver boundary.
Element end loads equivalent to distributed uniform and point loads, computed via shape-function integration.
Internal force/moment resultants (axial, shear, torsion, bending) at a fractional station along the pipe element.
Schema-facing record pairing a unit with its dimension, transform, canonical flag, factor/offset representation, provenance, and review status.
Decision accepting the D-01 unit-catalog basis on 2026-06-10 implemented by the B1 units crate.
